direction: A modern, mobile-first local business website for Brown's Tree Service that transfers the reference's editorial composition, generous whitespace, and restrained motion while using only verified business facts and original accessible colors.

reference_influences.principle: Editorial hero with full-bleed media and left-aligned headline
reference_influences.evidence: Desktop hero is 1440x1000 with h1 at x=32, white text on image
reference_influences.implementation: Full-bleed hero, left-aligned heading, overlay 0.55, image_fit cover

reference_influences.evidence: Desktop sections have 320px bottom padding; mobile 120px

reference_influences.principle: Sticky header with transparent surface over hero
reference_influences.evidence: Header is fixed, transparent background, transforms on scroll
reference_influences.implementation: Sticky nav, solid surface, logo left, CTA button

reference_influences.principle: Restrained motion with short fades and lifts

reference_influences.evidence: Headings and content start at x=32 on desktop and mobile
